title: Music Machine
description: A Minecraft mod allowing of control over individual tracks and their priorities
body:
# Music Machine
Music Machine is a client-side mod that gives you complete, granular control over Minecraft's dynamic background music. 

Tired of hearing the same track play when you're building? Wish the game played music a bit more often? Want to listen exclusively to the classic C418 soundtrack? Music Machine lets you do exactly that through an easy-to-use in-game configuration menu.

## 🎵 Features

### 🎛️ Complete Track Control
The mod automatically hooks into the game's music system and provides a categorized list of every single vanilla music track (Menu, Creative, Overworld, Nether, The End, etc.). From the config menu, you can:
* **Toggle Tracks**: Turn individual songs ON or OFF. Dislike a specific ambient track? Disable it forever.
* **Weight Sliders**: Adjust the "weight" of each track to increase or decrease its chance of playing. Boost the odds of hearing your favorite songs!
* **Resource Pack Support**: Playing with custom music from resource packs? Music Machine automatically detects and registers custom tracks from your `sounds.json` files so you can toggle and weigh them just like vanilla tracks!

### ⏱️ Music Frequency Settings
Take control of how often music actually plays in your world. The config allows you to switch between four distinct modes:
* **Never**: Completely mutes all background music.
* **Sometimes**: The standard vanilla pacing with long delays between tracks.
* **Often**: Shortens the delays so music plays more frequently.
* **Nonstop**: Music loops continuously with almost zero downtime between tracks.

### 🎭 Pre-Configured Profiles
Don't want to manually tweak every song? Use the built-in music profiles to instantly change the vibe:
* **Default**: Plays all tracks exactly as vanilla Minecraft intended.
* **Legacy**: Automatically restricts all music to only tracks composed by C418.
* **Custom**: Activates your personalized settings, custom toggles, and track weights.

### 💿 "Now Playing" Display
When opening the configuration menu, a stylish animated display will show you the exact title and author of the song currently playing in the background.

## ⚙️ How to Use
1. Install the mod on your client.
2. Launch the game and load into a world.
3. Press **`M`** on your keyboard (rebindable in the Controls menu) to open the music management screen.
4. Adjust the settings to your liking—changes apply instantly!

## 🛠️ Compatibility & Installation
* **Supported Loaders**: Available for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge (refer to the downloads section for specific Minecraft versions). *Note: Fabric users must install the Fabric API.*
* **Environment**: Client-Side Only. You can install this on your client and safely connect to vanilla servers, realms, or modded servers without the server needing the mod installed.

[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/misikonik/Music-Machine)
